messages:
Isha: Quick thread — light refresh for the Spark quickstart. Goals: unify env var to RW_API_KEY, add a 1-file websocket echo example, and fix the dead anchor to /deploy/production#quick-start.
Dmitri: SGTM. Which files will change? README, samples/.env.example, docker-compose.yml, and the JS snippet.
Sam: I ran the sample and got 401 because .env had REDWOOD_API_KEY while README shows RW_API_KEY. Easy mismatch.
Isha: I'll rename the env var in samples and add a short migration note for old REDWOOD_API_KEY users. Also include a tiny migrate-env.sh that copies old var if present.
Dmitri: For the WS snippet, keep it tiny (raw ws + auth header). Suggest 8 lines. Also update the JS SDK streaming snippet to async iterator.
Rae: CI flagged node:16 in Dockerfile; streaming needs node>=18. I'll update package.json engines and Dockerfile in the samples.
Isha: Branch docs/spark-quickstart-refresh created and PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8599. PR body lists env rename, WS example, node update, anchor fix.
DocsBot: Link check queued for PR #8599
Sam: I pushed a short README tweak and the migrate script. Running local smoke now.
DocsBot: Link check passed for PR #8599
Dmitri: CI green on linux/macos. Windows runner flaky for volume mounts; added a short PS note in README.
Isha: Thanks all — requesting reviews from Dmitri/Sam. Target merge tomorrow AM if CI stays green. Ping here if anything blocks.
Sam: :eyes:
